valuationPolicy.reason: Holder consideration is a warrant security outside the frozen daily common-stock valuation corpus. The successor OAS common stock is not the old holder's successor security; it was issued to noteholders. A complete mark-to-market holder return cannot be reconstructed from the authorized stock-price corpus.

precedent.principle: An unvalued warrant leg blocks complete holder-consideration valuation rather than being silently discarded or mapped to successor common stock.
